g.text: REJECT: PUSHER, PADDLE, LOCKED BIN, EYE BRACKETS
Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-406 Metal detector conveyor (built frame, used head) · rev B
SS 304 (ASTM A240 sheet + plate / A554 tube / A276 bar); UHMW paddle
No product contact (pack closed): #4 brushed or bead blast; passivate ASTM A967
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5

svg.text: Plate 80 x 132 on the -y side plate (4 x Ø6.6 to P1-P4), shelf 80 x 254 carries the actuator body, rear plate holds the clevis pin Ø6 (H9).
Weld 3 fillet both sides; actuator axis along y at z 950, x 620.
Face 120 x 80 (pushes below the jar shoulder), edges R5; clevis block 24 x 30 x 20 with 2 nylon screws; pin Ø6 to the rod end.
Body 180 (x) x 260 (y) x 510; slot 150 x 120 in the -y wall centred on x 620;
lid hinged on the +y edge (piano hinge 304), hasp + padlock (P1-462), reed switch B3; 2 hooks 30 wide onto the +y plate top; drain hole Ø6.
Bottom in the middle; bend the 4 walls up 90° (IR 1.5); TIG the 4 corners and grind flush. Slot cut in the -y wall (lower panel).
Ø18.5 for the M18 eye (B1) or the reflector stud; 2 x Ø5.5 to the plate E holes
laser 3 pieces, weld, drill Ø6.2 clevis
saw, radius, drill; clevis drill Ø6.2
laser, bend, TIG, grind, hinge, hasp
1. Bin is part of CCP-1: it must be locked whenever the line runs (B3 lid switch stops the belt when open).
2. Pusher retracted: paddle face 8 outside the J guide line; extended: pack lands in the bin through the slot (ITP T10).
